weather_api.description: URL the weather data will come from up to required URL encoded variables. Changes may require rewrite of request parser in...

location_api.description: URL for finding nearby places to requests. Used for caching extra data that users may want. Changes may require rewrite of request parser in...

cache.description: Parameters for chaching strategies. Used for both weather data and user request data

renew.description: controls if the cache should self renew and the default time between renews

remove.description: controls if cache should remove information and how old data should be allowed to be

overload.description: controls if the cache should gather extra data the user may want. currently grabs geographically 'close' locations and how many itterations of that distance should happen
